artifacts.name: The Aeolian Tuning Fork
artifacts.description: A silver tool used by ancient Goblins to 'play' the wind currents of the multiverse. Reveals hidden paths within Storm Clouds.
artifacts.arc_utility: Essential for navigating the Shattered Soundscape arc.

artifacts.name: Bottled Solar Flare
artifacts.description: A piece of a dying sun corked inside a Whisper Crystal vial. Provides light and heat in the darkest reaches.
artifacts.arc_utility: Required to survive the Deep Dark or Frozen Realm arcs.

artifacts.name: Chrono-Compass
artifacts.description: A finicky device favored by Aristotle for those 'purr-fect' escapes. Allows a brief rewind of ship movement.
artifacts.arc_utility: Facilitates branching narrative choices by allowing a vision of outcomes.

artifacts.name: Midas's Grapnel
artifacts.description: An enchanted golden claw that never loses its grip on treasure. Adds a grapple mechanic to combat.
artifacts.arc_utility: Used in mid-game arcs to scavenge derelict knight-ships.

artifacts.name: Fairy Dust Scrubber
artifacts.description: Bellows and brushes that coat the ship in shimmering invisibility. Reduces detection and passes magical barriers.
artifacts.arc_utility: Necessary for the Diplomatic arcs involving the Fae Courts.
